item.title: Revert redundant doc check from Maturity Protocol Phase 2
item.intent: The developer prompt must be concise and non-repetitive — saying the same instruction twice wastes context tokens and dilutes signal.
item.description: We added a doc check to Phase 2 of the Maturity Protocol that duplicates the Documentation Maintenance section injected 10 lines earlier. Phase 2 should stay focused on its core job: bugs, AC verification, edge cases. Remove the doc-check clause from Phase 2 while keeping the standalone Documentation Maintenance section.
steps: In build_agent_prompt(), revert the Phase 2 Critique text to remove the doc-check clause
Keep the standalone Documentation Maintenance section intact (lines 1634-1640)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Phase 2 text does not mention documentation or docs
Documentation Maintenance section still exists as a separate injection
